title: Gifts, Holidays & Celebrations Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thankyou:note
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most gifts, holidays events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `thankyou:note` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your gifts, holidays data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
